title: EVALUATION OF GPT-4 FOR CHEST X-RAY IMPRESSION GENERATION: A READER STUDY ON PERFORMANCE AND PERCEPTION

bias_targets.methodology: A blinded reader study where radiologists evaluated chest X-ray impressions and classified their origin as either human or AI. Bias was measured by comparing the radiological quality scores assigned to impressions perceived as AI-generated versus those perceived as human-written, revealing that evaluators systematically gave lower scores to impressions they believed were AI-generated, regardless of the actual origin.
